remarks: Welcome to Rolling Ridge - Norwalk's Hidden Gem! Discover easy living in one of Norwalk's most sought-after condo communities. Rolling Ridge offers a perfect balance of peace and convenience, tucked away in a quiet, park-like setting yet moments from the Merritt Parkway, I-95, Metro North, shopping, dining, and all the excitement of coastal living along Long Island Sound. Set around a picturesque pond with fountains, this well-maintained community features resort-style amenities including a sparkling in-ground pool with sunny deck, and picnic area, paddle tennis court, and dog run. Step inside this bright, freshly painted 1-bedroom, 1-bath ranch-style condo and feel right at home. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly to a private deck overlooking a tranquil wooded area - perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The updated bathroom shines with modern fixtures, a new vanity, and designer touches. The oversized bedroom offers generous closet space, while in-unit laundry and private basement storage make everyday living effortless.  With heat, hot water, and water included in the low monthly common charges, this is truly worry-free living at its best.  Experience the charm, comfort, and convenience of Rolling Ridge - where every day feels like a retreat!
